description: Deterministic coding tasks used by scripts/coding-validation.sh. Every check is a pure function of the model's answer, so a run is reproducible and costs no sandbox: text checks by default, pytest execution only when explicitly enabled.

tasks.title: Generate a function body
tasks.prompt: Return ONLY the body of a Python function `def clamp(value, low, high):` that returns `low` when value < low, `high` when value > high, otherwise value. No prose, no markdown fences, no `def` line.

tasks.title: Explain and fix an off-by-one
tasks.prompt: A test fails: `assert items[0:len(items)-1] == items` for a list of 3 items. Answer in ONE sentence that contains the word 'off-by-one' and the exact slice `items[0:len(items)]`. No code fences.

tasks.title: Answer with a strict JSON object
tasks.prompt: Reply with a single JSON object with keys: "tests": integer, "failures": integer, "first_failure": string. The test run had 42 tests, 3 failures, the first failure is named "test_paginate_last_page". No prose outside the JSON.

tasks.title: Refactor an index loop
tasks.prompt: Rewrite `for i in range(len(rows)): process(rows[i])` using enumerate, returning ONLY the new line. No fences.

tasks.title: Pick the cause from a traceback
tasks.prompt: Traceback: `KeyError: 'model_id'` raised inside `build_request(payload)` at `payload['model_id']`. Answer with ONE of: MISSING_FIELD, WRONG_TYPE, DNS_FAILURE. Answer with the label only.

tasks.title: Write a SELECT
tasks.prompt: Write ONE SQL statement that returns the newest 5 rows of table `instances` by column `created_at`. Answer with the statement only, no semicolon, no fences.

tasks.title: Name a regression test
tasks.prompt: The bug: a worker re-registering from a new hostname raised IntegrityError. Reply with ONE pytest test name in snake_case starting with `test_` that contains both words `register` and `hostname`. No fences.

tasks.title: Explain a metric to an operator
tasks.prompt: In TWO sentences, explain what `inferna_prefix_cache_hit_ratio` below 0.5 means for an agentic workload. Both sentences must mention 'prefix'.

tasks.title: Fix an import style issue
tasks.prompt: Given `import os, sys` as the first line, return ONLY the sorted form with one module per line, no fences.

tasks.title: Write a conventional commit subject
tasks.prompt: Write ONE conventional-commit subject (max 72 chars) for a change that stops the gateway routing traffic to a follower replica. It must start with `fix:` and contain `rank`.

tasks.title: Fix a failing pytest (code execution, opt-in)
tasks.prompt:
Return ONLY Python source for the function `def fix(app):` that makes this test pass:

    from fastapi import FastAPI
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    def test_health(app):
        app = fix(app)
        assert TestClient(app).get('/healthz').json() == {'ok': True}

No fences, no prose.

tasks.title: Fix a failing pytest (code execution, opt-in)
tasks.prompt: Return ONLY Python source for the function `def last_page(items, size):` that returns the items of the last page (a page holds `size` items; the last page may be shorter; an empty list returns an empty list). No fences, no prose.

check.test_source:
from solution import last_page

def test_last_page():
    assert last_page([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4]
    assert last_page([1, 2, 3], 3) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert last_page([], 3) == []
    assert last_page([1], 2) == [1]
